about: Pavo's native speech (story QA v4, owner 27/10 R4): each speaker's fixed voice description, sent word for word in every native request (pavo_native.sound_sentence), and its reference clip, against which every later speech clip of that speaker is judged (rights.ai_video.speech_checks: cosine >= voice_same_character_cosine_min, and that much closer to it than to any other speaker's reference by voice_other_character_margin_min). A reference is chosen by Claude's review of a clip that passed every other check, by PR (episode_build.py voice-reference); it is never written by hand. Descriptions from the native-audio probe (evidence/pavo/20261027/native-audio-probe, PR #473, prompt A).
